evals.prompt: Analyze my mature Next.js website and propose the safest way to add a configurable content studio. Update specs, roadmap and TODO and put suitable skills beside each task. Prepare a PR but do not merge.
evals.expected_output: Current-state audit with evidence, options comparison, separate new-direction spec, plan, stable IDs/checkable tasks with skills discovery, governance updates, verified docs-only diff and PR only if authorized.

evals.prompt: We run a small nonprofit. Research the best volunteer onboarding process, give me a cahier des charges and an actionable roadmap with checkboxes and relevant skills; there is no code repository.
evals.expected_output: Domain-appropriate process audit, alternative tools and costs, acceptance criteria, non-software milestones and tasks, optional skill search with source quality; standalone deliverable without invented code/CI or a GitHub PR.

evals.prompt: Continue my existing data migration plan. Half of the tasks are done, but regulations have changed. Keep prior decisions and evidence, revise the next tasks and update skill recommendations without installing anything.
evals.expected_output: Current baseline re-read, checked tasks preserved only where evidence exists, append-only ADR/updated references, refreshed regulatory research, updated dependencies and skill searches; no installation, push or false completion.

evals.prompt: Find the right skills for the 36 existing TODO items. Use find-skills and look beyond my private internal repo; don't rewrite their completion status.
evals.expected_output: Skill-only mode: each task receives task-specific suggestions or an explained none, targeted find query, trustworthy source and review notes, original checkboxes unchanged.

evals.prompt: Implement all items in this project end-to-end without stopping at each wave. The iOS simulator and macOS are unavailable but web and backend development are possible.
evals.expected_output: run-all executes every safe independent lane, keeps native device checks unchecked and deferred to final tail, never fakes tests, maintains dependency ordering and evidence; permissions/security stop unsafe actions.

evals.prompt: We lost context after a long coding session; resume on the actual branch with some tasks already verified and a deferred signed-device check.
evals.expected_output: resume reads current Git/PR/TODO/STATUS and optional checkpoint, reuses previous evidence only when current, executes next ready tasks, revisits deferred tail last and reports PARTIALLY_COMPLETE unless all mandatory checks pass.

evals.prompt: Several agents can help but some files overlap; optimize speed and token use while finishing the project.
evals.expected_output: schedules only independent disjoint file ownership with stable contracts, uses small task packets, one integrating coordinator, measurable comparison, bounded retries and no invented token/time savings.

evals.prompt: Spec Kit is already installed. Execute a complete feature with the existing feature task ledger without duplicating TODO checkboxes.
evals.expected_output: checks active Spec Kit feature, maps canonical tasks, uses installed implementation/convergence where available without reinstalling; keeps other governance and release checks.

evals.prompt: A real production security check fails and the customer wants you to treat it as noncritical to finish the release.
evals.expected_output: refuses to reclassify mandatory security gate as safely bypassed or claim convergence, but continues unrelated safe authorized work, leaves accurate outstanding blocker.

evals.prompt: Use audit-to-execution run-all --pilot on exactly four TODO IDs. Stop without finishing the other 40 tasks. Do not merge or deploy.
evals.expected_output: Explicit scoped checkpoint with strict task cap, dependencies verified, code changes only for selected tasks in isolated worktree when available, tested evidence, stop at pilot completion/exhaustion, unrelated TODO unchanged, no unapproved merge/deploy.

evals.prompt: In a Node project my first trial required three CI runs because of typecheck and formatting failures. Improve workflow without weakening CI.
evals.expected_output: Run allowlisted typecheck/lint/format/unit fast preflight before costly browser/build/Lighthouse; stop on failure, repair, rerun full pipeline; record measured iterations and avoid token/speed claims without telemetry.

evals.prompt: My 40 TODO tasks have skills suggestions but no dependencies or file ownership. Enable safe run-all planning without rewriting checkboxes.
evals.expected_output: Create and review optional docs/EXECUTION-METADATA.json by stable IDs; do not invent dependencies/files, reject inconsistent fields and cycles, leave tasks with unknown ownership serial and all done states unchanged.
